title: 3R-graded GenAI-assisted Java assignment example
summary: In a proposed programming example, students may use ChatGPT to generate a Java program but must report its use, attach the original output, make meaningful code contributions, and reflect on learning. The 3R rubric places 80% of its process weight on revision, so superficial renaming or comments sharply reduce the final grade.
